about_the_game:
Explore and Escape

After sneaking in, explore the compound and find your way out of each area. There are  gardens, eerie corridors, labyrinths, art galleries, and more. For each newly visited area, your character will take a photo. Consult the photo album to help track your journey and ensure nothing is missed.

Investigate

Scrutinize artifacts with your sixth sense to discover what happened to visitors and the groundskeeper and ultimately, your connection to the Greenhouse.

Solve Puzzles

Physics and perspective puzzles create the path needed to move forward. Some puzzles are random and change each time you play.

Immersive Environment

The levels are vast, and like an open world, there is no loading between them which keeps you immersed from start to finish. Everything is designed to feel real and make you believe like you are there: the sound of the wind, your footsteps on various surfaces. Water ripples and slows you down as you walk through it. Foliage bends and rustles as you brush past it.

Change the Weather

The world of GREENHOUSE is surreal. Pick up umbrellas, beach balls or sunglasses to change the weather. Make it rain, hail or shine to match the mood you want.

Wander Alone or Activate Entities

Choose a haunting walk filled with beauty and dread or enable each entity type and jump scares individually to customise your experience. Fend off venomous insects with bug spray. Encounter ghosts, some may help you or attack you. If you see the Groundskeeper... run for your life!

name: Greenhouse

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (or later)
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (from 2017 or later)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (or later)
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (from 2019 or later)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Sneak into a surreal greenhouse. Use your psychic visions to reveal why it was closed. Solve perspective-based puzzles and change the weather to twist the atmosphere. Toggle entities to turn exploration into survival.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Czech, Japanese, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish, Ukrainian, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
